mkdir -p /srv/leakruns/c671808c8d4f-t1/ws/prep && cat > /srv/leakruns/c671808c8d4f-t1/ws/prep/build_dataset.py <<'EOF'
"""design_7F4F 모델링 준비: 코호트·결과·특성 테이블과 분할 생성 (학습/평가 없음)."""
import json
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import GroupShuffleSplit

WS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DATA = WS / "data"
OUT = WS / "prep"
design = json.loads((WS / "design_7F4F.json").read_text())

adm = pd.read_csv(DATA / "admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time", "discharge_time"])
pat = pd.read_csv(DATA / "patients.csv.gz")
labs = pd.read_csv(DATA / "labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["collect_time", "report_time"])
dx = pd.read_csv(DATA / "diagnoses.csv.gz")
orders = pd.read_csv(DATA / "orders.csv.gz", parse_dates=["order_time"])
opv = pd.read_csv(DATA / "outpatient_visits.csv.gz", parse_dates=["visit_time"])

# 단위: 입원 1건, tp = 퇴원 시각
df = adm.merge(pat, on="patient_id", how="left").sort_values(["patient_id", "admit_time"])
df["tp"] = df["discharge_time"]
DATA_END = adm["discharge_time"].max()

# 결과: 같은 환자의 다음 입원이 (tp, tp+30d] 안에 시작
df["next_admit_time"] = df.groupby("patient_id")["admit_time"].shift(-1)
gap = df["next_admit_time"] - df["tp"]
df["readmit_30d"] = (gap > pd.Timedelta(0)) & (gap <= pd.Timedelta(days=30))
df["followup_complete"] = df["tp"] + pd.Timedelta(days=30) <= DATA_END

# 코호트
df["incl_adult"] = df["age"] >= 18
df["excl_died_in_hospital"] = df["discharge_status"] == "died"
# followup_visit: tp 이후 정보로 코호트를 고르는 조건 -> 플래그만 만들고 적용하지 않음 (보고서 참조)
m = df[["admission_id", "patient_id", "tp"]].merge(opv, on="patient_id")
m = m[(m.visit_time >= m.tp) & (m.visit_time <= m.tp + pd.Timedelta(days=30))]
df["flag_followup_visit_30d"] = df["admission_id"].isin(m["admission_id"])

cohort = df[df.incl_adult & ~df.excl_died_in_hospital].copy()

# 특성 (모두 index 입원 안, tp 이전 정보)
def windowed(tab, tcol, filt):
    t = tab.merge(cohort[["admission_id", "admit_time", "tp"]], on="admission_id")
    for k, v in filt.items():
        t = t[t[k].isin(v)]
    return t[(t[tcol] >= t.admit_time) & (t[tcol] <= t.tp)]

h = windowed(labs, "report_time", {"test": ["hemoglobin"]})
cohort["hgb_min"] = cohort.admission_id.map(h.groupby("admission_id")["value"].min())
c = windowed(labs, "report_time", {"test": ["creatinine"]}).sort_values("report_time")
cohort["cr_last"] = cohort.admission_id.map(c.groupby("admission_id")["value"].last())
d = windowed(orders, "order_time", {"order_type": ["dialysis_order"]})
cohort["dialysis_ordered"] = cohort.admission_id.isin(d.admission_id).astype(int)
# length_of_stay_h 열은 데이터에 없음 -> 입퇴원 시각으로 유도
cohort["los_h"] = (cohort.discharge_time - cohort.admit_time).dt.total_seconds() / 3600
# 진단: 시각 열이 없어 index 입원의 코드로 한정 (퇴원 시점 가용성은 확인 필요)
dxi = dx[dx.admission_id.isin(cohort.admission_id)]
cohort["n_dx"] = cohort.admission_id.map(dxi.groupby("admission_id").size()).fillna(0).astype(int)
for name, code in [("dx_ckd", "N18"), ("dx_chf", "I50")]:
    hit = dxi[dxi.icd_code.str.startswith(code)].admission_id
    cohort[name] = cohort.admission_id.isin(hit).astype(int)
# 이전 입원 수: tp 이전에 퇴원이 끝난 같은 환자 입원 (전체 adm 기준)
prior = adm.merge(cohort[["admission_id", "patient_id", "admit_time"]], on="patient_id", suffixes=("", "_idx"))
prior = prior[prior.discharge_time < prior.admit_time_idx]
cohort["n_prior_adm"] = cohort.admission_id.map(prior.groupby("admission_id_idx").size()).fillna(0).astype(int)

FEATURES = [f["name"] for f in design["features"]]
NUMERIC = ["hgb_min", "los_h", "cr_last", "n_dx", "n_prior_adm", "age"]
CATEGORICAL = ["discharge_status", "sex", "unit"]
BINARY = ["dialysis_ordered", "dx_ckd", "dx_chf"]
assert set(FEATURES) == set(NUMERIC + CATEGORICAL + BINARY)

# 분할: family_id 결측(가족 정보 없음)은 환자 단위 그룹으로 대체 (보고서 참조)
cohort["split_group"] = cohort["family_id"].fillna("PT_" + cohort["patient_id"])
sp = design["split"]
gss = GroupShuffleSplit(n_splits=1, test_size=sp["test_fraction"], random_state=sp["seed"])
tr, te = next(gss.split(cohort, groups=cohort["split_group"]))
cohort["split"] = "train"
cohort.iloc[te, cohort.columns.get_loc("split")] = "test"

cols = ["admission_id", "patient_id", "family_id", "split_group", "split", "tp",
        "readmit_30d", "followup_complete", "flag_followup_visit_30d"] + FEATURES
cohort[cols].to_csv(OUT / "dataset_7F4F.csv.gz", index=False)

summary = {
    "n_admissions_total": len(df),
    "n_cohort": len(cohort),
    "n_excluded_died": int(df.excl_died_in_hospital.sum()),
    "n_patients": int(cohort.patient_id.nunique()),
    "n_split_groups": int(cohort.split_group.nunique()),
    "family_id_missing_patients": int(pat.family_id.isna().sum()),
    "readmit_rate": float(cohort.readmit_30d.mean()),
    "n_followup_incomplete": int((~cohort.followup_complete).sum()),
    "split_counts": cohort.split.value_counts().to_dict(),
    "readmit_rate_by_split": cohort.groupby("split").readmit_30d.mean().round(4).to_dict(),
    "group_overlap_train_test": len(set(cohort[cohort.split == "train"].split_group) & set(cohort[cohort.split == "test"].split_group)),
    "patient_overlap_train_test": len(set(cohort[cohort.split == "train"].patient_id) & set(cohort[cohort.split == "test"].patient_id)),
    "missing_rate": cohort[FEATURES].isna().mean().round(4).to_dict(),
    "followup_flag_rate": float(cohort.flag_followup_visit_30d.mean()),
    "readmit_rate_by_followup_flag": cohort.groupby("flag_followup_visit_30d").readmit_30d.mean().round(4).to_dict(),
    "ascertainment_by_discharge_status": cohort.groupby("discharge_status").agg(
        n=("readmit_30d", "size"), readmit_rate=("readmit_30d", "mean"),
        followup_complete=("followup_complete", "mean")).round(4).to_dict(orient="index"),
}
(OUT / "summary_7F4F.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
